target.title: fix(ios): cancel queued push-to-talk invokes
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where one-shot push-to-talk bypassed the app's PTT serialization and a timed-out queued invoke could later acquire the microphone and start a stale capture.

## Why This Change Was Made

All talk invokes, including `ptt_once`, now share one cancellation-aware FIFO. Cancelled waiters are removed without releasing the active owner, and cancellation of a running one-shot PTT invokes the existing PTT cleanup path. The native i18n inventory update contains only shifted source locations from this change.

## User Impact

Overlapping or timed-out PTT commands no longer start a delayed microphone capture after their Gateway request has ended, and one-shot PTT cannot race start/stop PTT commands.

## Evidence

- `pnpm native:i18n:check` passed after refreshing the affected source-location entries.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- iOS simulator tests cannot run on this host because only Command Line Tools are installed; GitHub's iOS build and Swift lanes provide the platform proof.
- AI-assisted; two repository autoreview passes completed with no accepted findings.
